SILT#00015: If you are working on GitHub workflows, there is a tool that can help you run and test it locally. It is called act (<https://github.com/nektos/act>) and uses Docker to simulate the GitHub hosted runner. This will help speed up the process of iterating on your workflow changes

## Additional Context

- Might have looked at it before, but never used it
- Inspired from "Lint like a Senior Dev ..." from Syntax YouTube channel
